title: Validated original-source enclosure at the corrected conditional-row ordinal
question: Can the original finite oscillator/Hamiltonian source be enclosed with a validated spectral residual certificate and propagated through Gibbs normalization, the corrected emission ordinal 7 row, the projected momentum graph and the blockwise residual eigenvalue?

new_perspective.principle: Use exact source radicals in directed interval arithmetic and exploit exchange/parity symmetry to compute high-precision block eigenvectors; bound the distance to an exact orthogonal basis from interval residual and Gram defects, then propagate the resulting Gibbs-kernel operator bound to the corrected row.
route: Build the declared V=2, d=16 oscillator and Hamiltonian source from rational fixture parameters as sparse real algebraic expressions; enclose every radical and arithmetic operation with mpmath.iv.

Split the source into the four commuting exchange/parity sectors of dimensions 72, 56, 64 and 64, diagonalize each block at 50 decimal digits, and merge the block eigenpairs without using a full 256-dimensional high-precision eigensolve.

Use directed interval residual and orthogonality bounds plus the polar correction inequality to enclose the source Gibbs kernel exp(-beta(H-L I)); independently enclose the 16-dimensional coordinate oscillator basis and momentum matrix.

Propagate those bounds through the coordinate diagonal, the parent-6 conditional row (emission ordinal 7), the fixed core/tail split, and an interval residual compression; certify a lower probe by interval Cholesky and an upper probe by an interval Rayleigh quotient.
Repeat with a non-importing independent implementation and hostile row/index/source-promotion mutations; keep all physical and continuum promotion flags false.
new_perspective.qft_bridge: This can certify one finite original-source residual interval, but it does not provide a common unbounded Q3 core, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a physical sector, Yang-Mills dynamics or a mass gap.

interval_contract.arithmetic: mpmath.iv directed intervals for source expressions and final probes, with midpoint/radius propagation for the 256-column residual and Gibbs-kernel tables
interval_contract.conditioning_note: The finite residual-basis interval dependency is bounded by the explicit 1e-8 matrix-width threshold; this is a finite conditioning bound, not a uniform estimate.

assumptions: The R-419 finite fixture is the exact declared source for the V=2, d=16 calculation and the R-432 emission ordinal contract is unchanged.
Exchange and global Fock-parity symmetries commute with the finite source Hamiltonian, so the four displayed block reductions preserve the spectrum.
The polar correction bound used in the certificate is applied only after directed interval residual and Gram-defect bounds are below one half.
For a positive self-adjoint finite matrix, exp(-beta X) is beta-Lipschitz in operator norm on the shifted positive cone; the coordinate-vector perturbation bound uses ||K||<=1.
The interval Cholesky lower certificate and interval Rayleigh upper certificate are applied to the same symmetric compressed residual enclosure.
missing_assumptions: A cutoff-, volume-, phase- and exhaustion-uniform version of the finite source enclosure.
A common unbounded Q3 core and a uniform residual or Schur estimate beyond this one finite source.
History transfer, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, physical-sector admission and continuum control.
A same-owner normalized physical-empty branch E and the full Reading-H functional required for the three physical-empty tests.
stop_conditions: If any symmetry block fails to reproduce the source residual or interval Gram bound, classify the source enclosure as inconclusive and retain R-432 without promotion.
If the propagated row interval crosses the tail threshold, a fixed probe, or either reference separation threshold, report the exact interval and do not call the source route certified.
If any hostile mutation is accepted, fail the integrated verifier rather than relaxing the row, tolerance, source or scope contract.
Never promote one finite interval certificate to a physical, Yang-Mills, mass-gap, common-core or continuum theorem.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED VALIDATED FINITE ORIGINAL-SOURCE INTERVAL ENCLOSURE; NO UNIFORM OR PHYSICAL PROMOTION
non_claims: No physical-empty energy sign, Reading-H full stationarity or symmetry-projected transverse stability result.
No cutoff-, volume-, phase- or exhaustion-uniform Schur, Poincare or residual theorem.
No common core, history transfer, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, sector gap or continuum limit.
No C6, Sector-A, Pre-A, Yang-Mills or mass-gap conclusion.
